selectionRule: A candidate becomes ADOPTED only after a bounded adapter, deterministic evidence, license review, replacement path and accepted close receipt exist.

candidates.name: Godot Engine
candidates.adapterBoundary: Godot consumes a compiled VexWorld package and produces one runtime/expression projection; scene/node identity never becomes canonical world meaning.
knownRisks: engine-specific scene conventions could leak into canonical source
large engine adoption could outpace the small behavioral oracle
binary/toolchain acquisition requires separate reproducible bootstrap

candidates.name: Rapier
candidates.adapterBoundary: Optional specialist physics adapter behind VexWorld collision/body/action contracts.
knownRisks: would add a second physics owner before need is proven
Rust/WASM/toolchain cost

candidates.name: Box2D
candidates.adapterBoundary: Mature 2D physics reference or alternative backend; never owns abilities, entities or world laws.
knownRisks: duplicates the selected engine physics path
C/C++ integration and deterministic-parity work

candidates.name: Jolt Physics
candidates.adapterBoundary: Future high-performance 3D physics candidate behind a stable body/joint/contact adapter.
knownRisks: premature for the current 2D proof
native integration and cross-platform build cost

candidates.name: Bevy
candidates.adapterBoundary: Potential data-oriented or simulation adapter; it would consume the same World Package rather than replace canonical semantics.
knownRisks: upstream identifies the engine as early-stage
breaking changes are expected frequently
Rust learning and compile-time cost

candidates.name: Babylon.js
candidates.adapterBoundary: Optional browser 3D expression adapter over compiled world state and glTF assets.
knownRisks: would broaden the current browser prototype before the Godot boundary is proven
web performance and browser compatibility envelope

candidates.name: glTF 2.0
candidates.adapterBoundary: Portable asset expression format; semantic identity, sockets, intents, rights and provenance remain in VexWorld sidecars.
knownRisks: format alone does not preserve gameplay semantics or complete rig intent
extensions and exporter differences require validation

candidates.name: VRM
candidates.adapterBoundary: Optional humanoid expression profile over glTF; never universalizes one body topology or gendered capability model.
knownRisks: humanoid focus does not cover all VexWorld vessels
runtime implementation compatibility varies

candidates.name: Blender
candidates.adapterBoundary: Authoring tool; VexWorld owns or properly licenses exported content and records source/output provenance separately.
knownRisks: tool license and created-content rights must not be collapsed
repeatable export profiles need source management
